summary: Ivanti shipped patches for two more chained Connect Secure zero-days requiring a second upgrade round while Alpine's GitLab near-miss proved CVE-2026-97229 is being exploited in the wild; new CVSS 10.0 flaws hit LXD and Linksys routers, the FBI attributed the $6.3B Binance heist to TraderTraitor with 600+ blocking addresses, and Chainalysis denied any Binance link as Polymarket, DHS, ARTEX, VOLTA and NetamLoader round out the delta.
